response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer (15+ years) with a CS degree, strong software-craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development), and one notable high-scale, low-latency systems stint at Sociomantic/dunnhumby. However, the role is a Principal/IC6 growth and experimentation specialist, and the resume shows no evidence of the core requirements: experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics platforms, statistical analysis, or bias/rollout-risk management. There is also little demonstrated principal-level scope — no multi-workstream initiatives, cross-org influence, or platform work adopted by many teams. He is a credible senior/staff full-stack or platform hire, but a stretch for this specific mandate; an interview would only make sense if the hiring bar on experimentation depth is flexible.
strengths: 15+ years across web, backend, mobile, embedded; C/C++, Java, C#, JS/TS
Proven high-throughput, low-latency service work (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic)
Strong testing/quality culture, open-source tooling authorship, and mentoring/teaching track record
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature flighting, or metrics-platform experience
Little evidence of principal-level scope: cross-team architecture, multi-workstream leadership
Weak demonstrated data/statistics aptitude and large-scale distributed multi-region ownership

key_factors.factor: Insufficient principal-level scope and cross-org influence
Deep, broad engineering experience with some high-scale systems
